scripts.create: claudia create --name DoUHave --region us-east-2 --handler lambda.handler --deploy-proxy-api --set-env-from-json dev.json --use-s3-bucket douhave-deployments --s3-key app.zip --timeout 900 --memory 1024 --aws-retries 0 --policies policies --profile douhave --layers arn:aws:lambda:us-east-2:946837758374:layer:chrome-aws-lambda:1
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run get-vars:dev && claudia update --version dev --set-env-from-json dev.json --use-s3-bucket douhave-deployments --s3-key app-dev.zip --profile douhave --layers arn:aws:lambda:us-east-2:946837758374:layer:chrome-aws-lambda:1
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run get-vars:prod && claudia update --version prod --set-env-from-json prod.json --use-s3-bucket douhave-deployments --s3-key app-prod.zip --profile douhave --layers arn:aws:lambda:us-east-2:946837758374:layer:chrome-aws-lambda:1
scripts.job:warm:dev: claudia add-scheduled-event --event events/warm.json --name douhave-warm-dev --version dev --rate '5 minutes' --profile douhave
scripts.job:warm:prod: claudia add-scheduled-event --event events/warm.json --name douhave-warm-prod --version prod --rate '5 minutes' --profile douhave
scripts.set-vars:dev: aws s3 cp dev.json s3://douhave-variables-dev/app.json --profile douhave
scripts.set-vars:prod: aws s3 cp prod.json s3://douhave-variables-prod/app.json --profile douhave
scripts.get-vars:dev: aws s3 cp s3://douhave-variables-dev/app.json dev.json --profile douhave
scripts.get-vars:prod: aws s3 cp s3://douhave-variables-prod/app.json prod.json --profile douhave
